hazard.name: IRIS
hazard.release: IRIS: The Imperial College Storm Model, global synthetic tropical cyclone event set, figshare collection version 1 (posted 2024-04-23), collection 10.6084/m9.figshare.c.6724251.v1 (main dataset 10.6084/m9.figshare.24894186.v1), basin NA, merged catalogue IRIS_NA_10000Y_merged.txt

index.definition: Maximum 1-minute sustained wind speed at 10 m above ground at the asset over the storm's lifetime: CLIMADA 6.1.0 TropCyclone.from_tracks intensity (wind model H08, intensity threshold 17.5 m/s, max 300 km from the eye, max latitude 61, no distance-to-coast cut-off), at a centroid placed on the asset; winds below the intensity threshold are stored as 0

scenario: IRIS 10,000-year synthetic tropical-cyclone catalogue for 67 locations. One row per storm whose track passes within 500 km of any location (13,902 storms, 7,988 of them with zero index and loss at every location); years without such a storm are implicit zero-loss years. Losses from CLIMADA's Emanuel (2011) USA tropical-cyclone impact function (v_thresh 25.7 m/s, v_half 74.7 m/s, scale 1). Each location's loss is the sum of the impacts on its cells (7,817 cells in all, wind at each cell centre); the index is computed at the location's lat/lon. No noise or vulnerability draws (draw_id 0). Value unit: USD (LitPop reference_year 2018); produced capital scaled from 2014 constant USD by CLIMADA, see research/notes/d2-florida-litpop-locations.md. Locations: Florida's 67 counties (location_id = county GEOID), each the sum of its LitPop cells and located at the cells' value-weighted centroid; the State of Florida is the single risk owner (D2, SPEC §6.6). Attribution: asset values from the CLIMADA data API, dataset LitPop_150arcsec_USA v3 (uuid 678e9551-32ca-40f3-9881-9bd38412c1cd), CC BY 4.0, Eberenz et al. (2020), Earth Syst. Sci. Data 12, 817-833, doi:10.5194/essd-12-817-2020, archive doi:10.3929/ethz-b-000331316; county boundaries: U.S. Census Bureau, 2025 TIGER/Line Shapefiles; hazard: IRIS (Sparks and Toumi 2024), data descriptor doi:10.1038/s41597-024-03250-y, collection doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.c.6724251.v1.

loss.aggregation: loss of a location = sum of the impacts on its cells (cells with a null location_id are left out); wind at each cell centre; vulnerability draws applied to the cells, one v_half per (event, draw_id) shared by every cell
